messages:
sophie_ml: Quick heads-up — during the new-model bring-up smoke runs we hit a de-dupe regression. A chunk of prompts from batch_2026-03-18-17 are not normalizing, so dedupe misses near-duplicates. Need triage.

mike_research: Which dedupe step? the fingerprint hashing or the tokenizer-normalize stage? :thinking_face:

sophie_ml: tokenizer-normalize. Example payload: non-breaking spaces and some invisible unicode. sample id: s_9f8a3b.

sophie_ml: ```
{"id":"s_9f8a3b","text":"How do I reset my password?\u00A0Please advise."}
```

tara_curator: That NBSP will change token offsets and hashing. We used to run NFKC + strip ctrl chars in curation, but ingest fast-path skipped normalization for microbatches.

jayden_platform: ingest fast-path intentionally set normalize:false for microbatches to hit perf SLOs. We recently enabled microbatch path for more endpoints. @anna_dataops flagged this as acceptable tradeoff.

anna_dataops: confirm — we toggled normalization off for microbatches (perf win) but didn't add a fallback for non-ascii heavy batches. We can add a per-batch "force_normalize" tag. Small change in worker.

sophie_ml: Proposed plan: 1) add batch-level normalization toggle, 2) re-run dedupe on affected 12,341 samples, 3) carve out 1,000 golden examples for human relabel and regression tests, 4) snapshot original and normalized blobs for rollback.

mike_research: Also: these samples will affect quantization evals. Tokenization change can alter embedding distributions and downstream BERTScore/recall. After relabeling, run quant smoke (int8,int4) and compare deltas. I'll add eval configs.

tara_curator: I'll assemble the golden slice and severity tags (close-dup, paraphrase, formatting-only). labeling-bot: please enqueue 1k for reviewers and mark priority high.

labeling-bot: enqueue request accepted -> queue id LQ-4472. ETA labeling start: after ingest re-run completes.

ingest-bot: pipeline update: re-run requested for batch_2026-03-18-17 with normalize:true and snapshot:true. Est. runtime 45m.

sophie_ml: Important: keep original pre-normalized snapshot under gs://redwood-curation/rollback/batch_2026-03-18-17 for model/qa repro.

anna_dataops: I'll open PR with toggle + snapshot script. PR: #4382. Will include unit tests for unicode edgecases.

jayden_platform: I'll do canary deploy to staging once PR merges, then run the re-ingest on staging cluster first. If good, promote to dedicated cluster. Pinged infra for quota check.

mike_research: After labeling finishes, run evaluation pipeline: compare baseline vs new-model on: ROUGE, BERTScore, embedding-recall@1/5, and quant-smoke. I'll attach eval json to the ticket.

tara_curator: timeline: PR today, staging canary tomorrow morning, re-ingest + labeling start after staging verification (~1.5h post-deploy), golden review by EOD tomorrow.

sophie_ml: If we find similar NBSP cases in other batches, drop IDs here and we'll include them in this pass. Thanks all. :thumbsup:

tara_curator: (reacted with :thumbsup:)
